name: smwmusic-sonic-r-super-sonic-racing-star-mix
title: Sonic R - Super Sonic Racing (Star-mix)
description:
Did a short arrangement of Super Sonic Racing from Sonic R because EVERYBODY SUPER SONIC RACING. TRY TO KEEP YOUR FEET RIGHT ON THE GROUND. WHEN YOU'RE SUPER SONIC RACING, THERE'S NO TIME TO LOOK AROUND.

Important:
ㅤ♠ "Bonus End," P-Switch, Yoshi SFX, & Thunder SFX are disabled.
ㅤ♠ Death sound is gonna sound weird (@0 replaces @9 to save on space).

There are also customizable versions for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
ㅤ1. C (Original Pitch)ㅤ[turned on by default]
ㅤ2. A# Minor (City Pitch)
ㅤ3. C# Minor (Custom Pitch)

There are also customizable versions for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
ㅤ1. Enables the Intro (INTRO Enabled)ㅤ [turned on by default]
ㅤ2. Skips the Intro (INTRO Disabled)
